description: Land Acquisition - Bandaragama, Bandaragama D/S Division, Kalutara District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, describing specific parcels of land to be acquired for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of land lots, their locations, extents, boundaries, and claimants, which falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
